description: Address code review feedback: fix chart data instability (replace Math.random with deterministic values), use Tailwind tokens instead of hardcoded hex, replace <a href> with React Router <Link>, add static data comment.
steps: Step 1 - Replace Math.random() in tokenCostData with deterministic formula using sine waves
Step 2 - Replace bg-[#1a1b2e] with bg-dark-surface and hover:bg-[#1e2035] with hover:bg-dark-card in Card.tsx
Step 3 - Replace bg-[#0f1117] with bg-dark-bg in Layout.tsx
Step 4 - Replace bg-[#12131f] with bg-dark-sidebar in Sidebar.tsx
Step 5 - Replace bg-[#0f1117] and bg-[#1a1b2e] with bg-dark-bg and bg-dark-surface in Header.tsx
Step 6 - Replace bg-[#0f1117] and bg-[#1a1b2e] instances in Dashboard.tsx with Tailwind tokens
Step 7 - Replace all <a href> with <Link to> in Dashboard.tsx, import Link from react-router-dom
Step 8 - Add comment noting static demo data is intentional
Step 9 - Run npm run build and verify zero errors
acceptance_criteria: No Math.random() in tokenCostData - uses deterministic sine wave formula
No hardcoded bg-[#0f1117], bg-[#1a1b2e], bg-[#12131f], bg-[#1e2035] in components - uses Tailwind tokens
No <a href> for internal navigation - uses <Link to> from react-router-dom
npm run build succeeds with zero errors
